context.hint: Check that a payment privacy rule compares destination identity consistently across supported address representations.
context.surface: A payment preview warns when a proposed destination matches a destination used previously.
assumptions: The same destination can have multiple supported forms.
Prior destinations may come from local records or reconstructed transaction history.

review.invariant: Equivalent supported representations of a previously used destination produce the same reuse warning.
review.verification: Compare the warning for two equivalent synthetic destinations in both representation orders. Confirm that the existing behavior for an unrelated destination still holds.

source_observation.summary: The original local check missed a warning for equivalent forms. The regression passed after the repair and covered both representation orders.
